name: Nudge Positive Energy
paletteStatus: Approved by user for app-wide implementation, 4 October 2026
accessibilityRefinement: Prototype light muted #68728A is darkened one RGB level to #677189 to clear 4.5:1 on canvas; this is not a new palette direction
scope: All Nudge-owned screens, shared controls, sheets and states; preserve artwork, provider branding and semantic score/safety meanings

roleRules.primaryAction: Yellow fill with dark primaryText in BOTH appearances; never white text
roleRules.selected: accent + selectedSurface + check + accessibility selected state
roleRules.plants: Use plantText for meaningful ring/tick contrast where plantAccent is too pale; plantAccent may be decorative
roleRules.scores: Nutrition number uses ink/accent. Final frequency uses independent green/amber/red labels; never use primaryFill as a score shortcut.
roleRules.safety: Use labelled/icon status treatment. successSurface is not evidence of allergen or recall safety
roleRules.camera: White overlay text requires a suitable dark scrim; do not tint food photos
roleRules.borders: border is quiet/decorative; use strongBorder or accent where a meaningful boundary needs stronger contrast

units: Logical points for native implementation; CSS pixels in the web specimen
typography: Use native semantic text styles with Dynamic Type; web specimen uses system fonts

nutritionScale.label: Nudge nutrition score
nutritionScale.rules: Exactly five outputs; derive category-correct grade first; no interpolation or old continuous ranges; nutrition number independent of final portion frequency; unknown is not zero

frequencyDisplay.source: Proposed Nudge v0.2 planning policy; not validated safe-frequency limits

bands.label: Monthly
bands.meaning: Up to 2 reference portions in rolling 28 days, shared within comparable Monthly choices

bands.label: Weekly
bands.meaning: Up to 2 reference portions in rolling 7 days, shared within comparable Weekly choices

bands.label: Daily
bands.meaning: Any day; appropriate portions and variety

frequencyDisplay.rules: Final frequency comes from the model and selected occasion; use solid full-opacity named badges and always-visible key; safety overrides encouragement, not nutrition grade; incomplete checks cannot imply clearance

targetedTidy.scope: Approved component tidy-up; no score or target recalibration

dial.label: Numeric score remains visible; these stronger arcs follow the supplied display reference

objectiveMetrics.reference: User-provided IMG_6100.HEIC, 4 October 2026. Applies to objective graphics, separately from food-score RAG and brand.

appearancePolicy: Light only, requested by user 22 October 2026. Dark tokens retained for future review but not applied.
